This item is not listed in the [8H6M69W4]. The location of the original is unknown, but a (photo)copy of the original could be obtained from gZan dkar rin po che and was printed in the [KUYBGM7V]. ([6TNNKSQ3]: 69)
The colophon names "brTson 'grus seng ge" as the scribe, but as this name is also given in the other instance of the work (ID:4711), we take it to be the scribe of the first copy of the work (ID:6843), from which this instance was directly or indirectly copied.
